name: agent-core-react-desktop
description: Electron React desktop sample powered by agent-core.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix ../../agent-core run build && concurrently "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../../agent-core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../../agent-core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
